en:
Himiko, you think that something fell
because of that <CLT=cltSTRONG>sound<CLT=cltNORMAL> you heard, right?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*BANG!*

It sounded like something heavy fell 
down and hit the floor really hard...
What could've fallen down?

Fallen down? There wasn't anything on the
ceiling that could've fallen down, right?

Nyeh? Am I wrong?
I thought something fell, but...

The sound was pretty loud. It did seem
like something hit the floorboards...

<CLT=cltMIND>Hmmm... A loud sound...
Like something hit the floorboards...

<CLT=cltMIND>Maybe that sound had something to do with
the other thing that happened in the dark.

If I could remember more about the sound,
I might be able to figure something out...

Well, it definitely wasn't something 
light that fell down.

Well whatevs, it doesn't matter what kind
of sound it made.

Isn't it more important to note that the
sound happened while it was dark?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Maybe...the iron cage made that sound?

The iron cage was heavy, but I don't think
there were any signs of it being moved.
I don't think that's the cause, do you?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

Maybe...the statue on top of the
cage made that sound?

It would be pretty loud if it dropped, but it 
was still on the cage after the seance.

It's not like you to forget something
like that, Shuichi.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

Maybe...it was the sound of the
sickle hitting the floor?

If it was that, it wouldn't have made such 
a loud sound. It musta been heavier.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

How troubling... We need to rely on Shuichi
and the other seance participants, but...

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

And? That has nothing to do with the
sound during the seance.

Nobody is gonna believe you anymore if 
you keep saying random things, y'know?
You don't get to say that!

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

What caused the sound that was
heard during the seance?

I think the floorboard coming off
had something to do with that sound.

That floorboard came loose at some
point during the seance, right?

Would the floorboard have made 
such a loud sound though?

It was the sound of an
intense impact...

If the impact was that intense, then
it could have loosened the floorboard.

<CLT=cltMIND>That is true. There would have had
to be a strong impact to make that sound.

<CLT=cltMIND>But what was it?
What could it possible be?

Alright then, let's go with that! We all 
gotta put our heads together now!
